info.title: Revision tip
info.text: Cover your notes and write the key facts from memory, then check. Testing yourself works much better than rereading.

info.title: Exam favourite
info.text: Questions often ask you to recommend wired or wireless for a scenario. Always link your choice to the scenario's needs.

info.title: Spot the address
info.text: If it has dots and numbers up to 255, it's IPv4. Colons and hex, it's IPv6. Dashes and hex pairs, it's a MAC address.

info.title: Protocol memory trick
info.text: SMTP 'Sends Mail To People'. POP 'Pulls Off Post'. IMAP 'I Manage All Places'.

info.title: Layers in one line
info.text: Each layer does one job and serves the layer above: that's the core idea to explain in the exam.

info.title: Marks matter
info.text: Look at the number of marks: a 2-mark 'explain' question usually needs a point and a reason.
